name: Cuevas Labradas (Spain)
description: White field with a diagonal band of blue, red and blue from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the upper fly with a black bear.
history: Municipal flag of Cuevas Labradas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band of blue, red and blue from the upper hoist to the lower fly
